# Kelpie Group

> Kelpie Group is run by Michelle Butts, a certified data scientist, retired teacher, and certified in AI marketing. She works online for small business owners. Public city: Savannah, Georgia. Kelpie Group started October 2026; Michelle has been doing this work for 4 years, including the years she ran a day spa.

## Who Michelle helps

- Independent salon and day spa owners with 1 to 6 chairs or rooms and no full-time receptionist.
- Everyday learners putting AI to work in a small business.

## What she does

- Free 30-Minute Workflow Audit: a one-to-one look at where bookings leak and what to fix first.
- 1-on-1 AI Power Session: $97, 45 minutes.
- Done-for-you booking engine: missed calls become booked appointments, counted in the owner's own booking system.
- Content packs for salons and spas.
- Other services are quoted after a free Workflow Audit.

## Brand promise

"Missed calls become booked appointments — counted in your own booking system, built on tools I own and you control, and never run without your approval."

## In her words

- "Teacher on the loose with dogs teaching AI to small business owners."
- "Owning your own content instead of signing up for all the shiny tools available."

## Free tool

- Booking Leak Calculator: https://kelpiegroup.net/leak-calculator.html — a free calculator for salon and spa owners that counts what missed calls, no-shows, and missed rebookings cost each month. No email needed; answers never leave the device.
